description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, exiling Pre-War Formalwear.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Pre-War Formalwear from exile to the battlefield.
When Pre-War Formalwear enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Pre-War Formalwear to it.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 5.
